structured_output.what_is_happening: This is one of at least 9 "DEBT COIN" ($DEBT) clones launched within about 30 minutes of each other. The narrative is linked to an Eric Bolling X post. The packet's project website even links to a different contract (FYM6…, about $976k market cap), which looks like the canonical leader. This clone is 14 minutes old. It went from $90k to $112k market cap on a burst of volume that fell off sharply: GeckoTerminal m5 volume is about $16k against $362k over m15. Its ATH market cap was about $190k and it is now well below that.
